benchmark: big-ann-benchmarks NeurIPS'23 streaming track, delete_runbook.yaml on msturing-10M-clustered

machine.cpu: Intel Core Ultra 9 185H, 22 threads, runs pinned to cores 0-7 (probes on 8-15 and 16-21)
machine.memory: 27 GiB shared host; each run under a systemd user scope with MemoryMax=8G (4G or 6G for the 1M probes), MemorySwapMax=0, nice 19
machine.note: recall runs on a shared host: wall times are upper bounds, not timing claims

parameters.adapter: neurips23/streaming/hms/hms.py: UpdatableIndex.create(degree=R, build_ef=L, alpha, threads=T); consolidate when delta >= 1.0 x base and >= 100k rows, or deleted >= 30% of base
parameters.python_wheel: maturin build --release --features python at HMS 791749b (main), the commit this change is built on

probes_1m_prefix.description: first 1,000,000 rows of the dataset inserted in 100k batches; recall@10 of the first 1,000 public queries against float64 brute-force ground truth over the 1M rows; 'self' queries are 1,000 rows sampled from the data
probes_1m_prefix.hms_commit: 791749b (alpha 1.0 rows, reservoir rows, code-bit rows) and ff70f3e (the other rows)

prior_session_1m_diagnostic.note: insert 1M, delete ids 0..100k, consolidate; 256 queries; recall@10 at ef 64/128/256/512

per_step_replay_first_12_steps.description: official runbook steps 1-12 replayed through UpdatableIndex with the adapter's consolidation policy; recall@10 of all 10,000 public queries against the harness ground truth at each search step; one pass measures both ef values
